text.tspan: Empty pads trigger a slice being captured during playback. Slices are populated in
the 4x4 blocks of pads starting bottom left. Green pads can be used to trigger slices.
Start Point of Sample or first Slice. Press to initially play sample to start manual slicing
Start Point of 2nd Slice. Press a lower pad while playing to capture the slice point
Start Point of 4th Slice. Press a lower pad while playing to capture the slice point
Start Point of 3rd Slice. Press a lower pad while playing to capture the slice point
Start Point of 5th Slice. Press a lower pad while playing to capture the slice point
Start Point of 6th Slice. Press a lower pad while playing to capture the slice point
